# MGIS 355 Project 2 instructions

This project uses synthetic seeded fishing-trip data to demonstrate a predictive pipeline, not to claim that real fish behave this way. The decision is for a Carolinas charter captain deciding the evening before whether to run a booked inshore or offshore trip or offer a reschedule. Use only the 13 evening-before features in `model.ipynb`; never use `bites_logged_during_trip`, `trip_id`, `trip_date`, or `season` as model features. Keep the time split (seasons 1-2 train, season 3 test), fit preprocessing inside pipelines on training rows only, compare majority and month-rule baselines, and report AUC, accuracy, and dollar cost. The app loads saved artifacts and never trains. Costs are $300 for running an unproductive trip and $600 for rescheduling a productive one; compute the threshold from those costs. Do not invent results or citations.
